conf.description: zos-racf racf-init, format other: hand-built IRRADU00 RACFINIT (SMF81) KVP-delimited parse, event.outcome constant per the work order's own instruction (no user identity, no outcome variance on this record type), YES/NO exit and SETROPTS columns collapsed into two bounded keyword arrays.

conf.comment: zos-racf/racf-init/other (IRRADU00 RACFINIT snapshot, SMF81, one record per IPL). Site formatter assumed KVP (literal RINI_ keys) per this technology's established precedent (zos-smf, zos-racf resource-access/racinit) -- not confirmed against a sample. event.outcome is a constant 'success' per the work order's own instruction (RACF only writes this record on successful init); user.name is deliberately left absent, there is no identity on this record type. RINI_AUDIT_USER/GROUP/DATASET collapse into racf.setropts.audit_classes and the five exit-flag columns collapse into racf.exits_active using the exit mnemonics the work order itself names (ICHRIX01/02, ICHRCX01/02, ICHDEX01) -- via code, not eval, so the arrays are cleanly filtered rather than holding null placeholders. No LPAR UTC offset is supplied so _time has no zone correction (gap). _raw is kept, unlike the higher-volume RACF datasets, per this dataset's own note that it 'can be carried indefinitely at negligible cost.'

functions.description: document KVP assumption, the outcome/identity constants, and the array-collapse design choice
extract RINI_-prefixed key=value tokens from the formatter's delimited output
event.outcome is always success per the work order (RACF only writes this record on successful initialization); _time from the concatenated date+time columns with no UTC correction (gap, see README)

collapse the three audit-class YES/NO columns and the five exit-flag YES/NO columns into two bounded keyword arrays, using the exit mnemonics the work order's own dataset description names for each column
batch rename every straightforward single-column mapped/custom field, no further transform needed

event.dataset/event.category (no hyphen), and cleanup of every raw key fully consumed above; _raw is deliberately KEPT (low IPL-frequency volume, per the work order's own 'carried indefinitely at negligible cost' note) unlike the higher-volume zos-racf datasets
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
